title: Features of the Formation and Development of Career Guidance Activities in Soviet and Post-Soviet Society
abstract: Background. The appeal to the historical experience of the formation and transformation of the vocational guidance system in Russia is conditioned by the need to understand the patterns of its development at the Soviet and modern stages . The analysis is carried out in order to develop effective strategies for professional self-determination of young people in the context of modern socio-economic challenges and educational policy reform . Objectives. The research aims to identify the main stages of the history of career guidance in the Soviet and post-Soviet periods, to determine their essential characteristics and problem areas, and to analyse the factors that have influenced the change in government policies in this field . Methods. The authors take a systematic approach to career guidance, considering it as an integral part of society . The article employs methods such as retrospective and comparative historical analysis, as well as analysis of legal regulations that have governed career guidance throughout different stages of history . title: Students’ Perception of Visual Aids Effectiveness in Teaching Arabic Grammar
abstract: Background. The use of visual aids in education remains significant as one of the fundamental didactic principles, gaining new forms due to the development of modern technologies . Despite the growing availability of digital tools, many instructional materials for teaching Arabic at the intermediate level contain a limited range of visualization means, which reduces the effectiveness of mastering complex grammatical structures . Objectives. The study aimed to analyze the preferences of undergraduate students regarding the forms of presenting Arabic grammar material and, based on the findings, to develop a system of visual aids adapted to learners’ needs . Methods. The research employed a questionnaire survey, comparative analysis, and expert evaluation . Study Participants . The study involved 74 second-year undergraduate students (aged 19-23), divided into two groups: Group 1 (2023/2024 academic year) and Group 2 (2024/2025 academic year) . Results. The majority of respondents confirmed that visual formats - such as schemes, tables, and graphic models - facilitate a deeper understanding of Arabic grammar . title: A Study of the Value-Semantic Unity of the International Educational Space of Friendly Countries
abstract: Background. The relevance of the research is determined by the need to identify similarities and differences in pedagogical attitudes and understanding of educational outcomes in different countries in order to develop flexible approaches to international cooperation that take into account both universal principles and national specifics . Objectives. The purpose of the study is to identify and analyze the value-semantic foundations that form the international educational space of friendly countries, as well as to identify ways to develop interstate cooperation in the field of education . Study Participants. The study involved 199 representatives of educational organizations from Russia and friendly countries . 56% of the respondents represent the higher education systems of their countries, the rest are teachers and heads of educational institutions . Methods . The socio-cultural approach served as methodological basis for the research . The research methods included: questionnaires; quantitative and qualitative analysis of the data obtained during the survey; content analysis of respondents’ open responses . Results. title: Current Trends in the Development of Higher Education System in Russia
abstract: Background. This article explores the purpose of Russian higher education in the current geopolitical context, where one of the key tasks of the Russian state is achieving a goal of national development . It is aimed at realizing the potential of every person, enhancing their talents, and up-bringing patriotic and socially responsible individuals . Ensuring progress in this direction is entrusted to the Russian education system, which is undergoing a reform and is increasingly playing a significant role in the development of modern society . Objective. The aim is to identify existing approaches to higher education management developed by Russian scholars and to summarize them in order to provide effective practical application, ensuring further development of Russian higher education . Methods. To explore the role of education in societal development and describe the current state of the higher education system, dialectical and historical approaches were used . Content analysis and expert assessments were employed in reviewing the research findings of various scholars and a vast array of official information . title: Forming Tolerance to Russian Culture in Foreign Students: Pedagogical Model and Technology in Russian as a Foreign Language (RFL) Classes
abstract: Background. International student mobility has traditionally been viewed as an indicator of a country’s academic integration . However, in the context of current political and sanction-driven changes, this understanding is shifting . The demand for online learning formats, short-term modules and double diploma programmes is growing . Universities now face the challenge of improving educational programmes and teaching methods for international students . This highlights the importance of developing educational approaches and maintaining institutional competitiveness . Objectives. The study aims to identify the pedagogical implications of the emerging trends and to develop evidence-based recommendations for organizing the educational process . Study Participants. The study involved 312 students from 15 countries and 20 experts in the field of international education programmes . Methods. A mixed-method design combining quantitative and qualitative analysis was used . The research applied surveys, semi-structured interviews, content analysis of policy documents (UNESCO, OECD) . title: Pedagogical Analysis of Student Mobility Trends: The Role of “Soft Power” and the Internationalization of the Learning Process
abstract: Background. The stable negative stereotypes about Russia among foreign students, formed by the media environment, hinders successful communication and increases the risk of cultural shock . Objective. The goal is to develop and approbate a holistic pedagogical technology forming tolerance toward Russian culture among foreign students during their studying Russian as a foreign language . Study Participants. The experimental group consists of 13 students (19-27 years old) from the University of Cadiz (Spain), with a background in the humanities and an A2 level of Russian language proficiency . Methods. Intragroup comparison “before and after”, quantitative analysis of the dynamics in the scores on a specialized test for tolerance . Results. After the implementation of the author’s pedagogical technology (model + meta-subject course “WORLD”), the average group indicator of the test for tolerance increased by 81 .49% . The maximum initial score (21 .88%) was improved . Three times as many students achieved it . abstract: Актуальность. title: MSU Students on their Education and Career Prospects: A Comparative Analysis of Millennials and Zoomers
abstract: Актуальность. На протяжении последних двадцати лет система высшего образования России претерпевает существенные трансформации, которые затрагивают все ее элементы. В этой связи особое значение приобретает сравнительный анализ мнений студентов, представляющих разные поколения: «миллениалов» и «зумеров». Объектом исследования выступали студенты МГУ. Работа была направлена на изучение представлений разных поколений студентов о качестве получаемого образования, своих карьерных и образовательных перспективах. Исследование дает возможность проследить, как меняется российское студенчество в новых социально-экономических и цифровых реалиях. Полученные результаты позволяют прогнозировать основные векторы развития национальной образовательной системы и разрабатывать меры, направленные на совершенствование образовательной политики. Цель. Изучить изменения, произошедшие за период с 2013 по 2023 г. в оценке студентами МГУ получаемого образования, выявить динамику их образовательных и профессиональных запросов и ценностных представлений. Коммуникативная мобильность в значительной мере влияет на успешность профессиональной реализации современного человека. abstract: Актуальность. Цифровая трансформация высшего образования обусловила необходимость пересмотра методологических основ обучения, в том числе обучения иностранным языкам. Для студентов неязыковых специальностей формирование иноязычной компетенции становится критически важным для профессиональной мобильности, однако традиционные подходы сталкиваются с дефицитом времени, низкой мотивацией и несоответствием содержания подготовки профессиональным задачам будущих специалистов. Цифровая образовательная среда (ЦОС) обладает потенциалом для решения этих проблем, но требует целостной методологической проработки. Цель. abstract: Актуальность. Цель. Обосновать возможности применения технологии эвристического обучения как способа реализации межпредметного и метапредметного подходов в образовательном процессе высшей школы для интеграции естественно-научных (географических) и гуманитарных компетенций. abstract: Актуальность. abstract: Актуальность. Внедрение в образовательную среду вузов России систем, созданных на основе технологий искусственного интеллекта (ИИ), формирует парадигму образования, которая потребует новых методологических подходов и педагогических приемов для полноценной реализации возможностей таких систем и избежания рисков, создаваемых этими технологиями. abstract: Актуальность. В условиях стремительного развития атомной энергетики существует острая потребность в подготовке высококвалифицированных специалистов, обладающих профессиональными компетенциями, соответствующими требованиям отрасли. Значительный разрыв между теоретической подготовкой выпускников вузов и практическими требованиями высокотехнологичных предприятий подчеркивает необходимость создания эффективных практико-ориентированных образовательных моделей. Цель. title: Stories (Bylichki and Byvalschiny) about Fainting (Obmiraniya) as a Form of Fixation of the Near-Death Experiences Model
abstract: Background. Near-death experience (NDE) is an altered state of consciousness experienced at the moment of near death, which has a specific structure (which includes such elements as an out-of-body experience, a feeling of movement in a dark tunnel, a review of life, visions of bright light, other realities and meetings with the dead, and many others) . The similarity of reports on the NDE of Russians in the 19th and 20th centuries with modern ones suggests the existence in Russian culture of a model of NDE - a set of ideas about the experiences of a dying person, which determines the formation of such an experience in a particular person . We assumed that Russian folklore is one of the forms of fixation of this model . Namely, we mean a genre of oral non-fabulous prose such as bylichki and byvalschiny (oral stories from the first and third person, respectively, about supernatural events that actually took place) about obmiraniya - cases when a person visits another world in a special state close to death . Objective. We conducted a search for the elements/components of NDE in the texts of stories - bylichki and byvalschiny - about obmiraniya . Methods. The material for our analysis
